```{webr}
library(dplyr)
d <- data.frame(g = c("a", "a", "b"), x = c(1, 2, 3), k = c("AGR", "IND", "AGR"))
s <- data.frame(k = c("AGR", "IND"), nome = c("Agro", "Industria"))
d |> left_join(s, by = "k") |> mutate(f = case_when(x < 2 ~ "baixo", x < 3 ~ "medio", TRUE ~ "alto"))
d |> count(g)
d |> group_by(g) |> summarise(n = n(), media = mean(x), .groups = "drop")
```

```{webr}
library(tidyr)
w <- d |> group_by(g, k) |> summarise(x = sum(x), .groups = "drop") |> pivot_wider(names_from = k, values_from = x)
w
w |> pivot_longer(cols = c(AGR, IND), names_to = "k", values_to = "x")
```

```{webr}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(d, aes(g, x)) + geom_boxplot() + facet_wrap(~ k) + theme_minimal()
```
